_comment: Sample content for the demo import (inc/demo-import.php) and the catalogue screenshots. Pages hold block markup; <!-- wp:pattern {"slug":"..."} /--> is expanded into the pattern's blocks on import. "{{theme}}" stands for the theme folder URL. "screens" lists the URL of each catalogue page. "productCategories", "productTags" and "products" are imported by inc/woo-import.php, only while WooCommerce is active. The house address, hours and shipping note, the scent-notes legend and the shelf with its prices and badge are not in this file: they live in synced patterns (inc/shared-info.php, inc/info/*.html) that every page references.

site.title: Kuyuru Incense
site.tagline: Hand-rolled incense from Kyoto, forty minutes at a time.

posts.title: How long should a stick burn?
posts.excerpt: Forty minutes is our standard, but half a stick is often enough. Notes on choosing a length for the room.
posts.content:
Forty minutes is our standard, but half a stick is often enough. Notes on choosing a length for the room.

At the counter

We light one stick at a time and wait. The first minutes tell you little; the heart, around minute twenty, tells you almost everything.

Write down what you notice: a wood, a flower, a spice. It helps far more than any description on a box.

At home

Burn it in the room you will use it in, at the time of day you will use it. A stick that feels heavy at noon can be just right after dark.

Smoke is slow. Let it be slow.

Haru Ōmine
